# cat-harness-tools-src

The MCP and HTTP server — what `bun run cat start` and `.mcp.json` start, from `src/index.ts`: the composition roots (`server.ts`, `route-groups.ts`, `tool-groups.ts`), the plug-in contract `types.ts`, the MCP tool registrars (`tools/`), the harness's own routes (`routes/`), authentication (`auth/`, `core/github-auth.ts`), access control (`core/rbac.ts`), the MCP projection (`mcp/`) and the no-content adapter. The Tool nodes it serves are declared in `cat-harness/tools/` with their `src/tools/*` paths, and the loader finds each module here through `needs`. Content routes (feedback, glossary, relevance) live in the content layer that owns their content, and the route loader finds them the same way.

Part of [C@T Harness Tools](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `cat-harness-tools-src`, holding `code`.
